title: A parked bicycle
passage: A. A cyclist is riding up a hill. B. A bicycle is parked next to a tree. C. A bicycle is hanging from a ceiling. D. A tree is being cut down beside a truck.
passageZh:
A. 一名自行車騎士正騎車上坡。
B. 一輛自行車停在樹旁。
C. 一輛自行車吊在天花板上。
D. 一棵樹正在卡車旁被砍倒。
